title: 见家长

series.next: 林老师 has built 老黄's son's flat. 老黄 has to knock.

setting: 彩排工作室, 10 am. On Sunday you tell your parents you've quit your job.

lin.name: 林老师
lin.en: runs the studio; has never smiled

laohuang.name: 老黄
laohuang.en: an actor: plays your mother, in an apron

steps.zh: 早！我现在是林老师的助理。
steps.en: Morning! I'm 林老师's assistant now.

else.zh: 押金的事，下午接着练。茶在保温杯里。
else.en: The deposit: we carry on this afternoon. The tea's in a flask.

steps.narr: A warehouse. Inside it, your parents' living room, full size. Your father is a cardboard cutout.

steps.zh: 周日晚饭。你要说：你辞职了。
steps.en: Sunday dinner. You have to say it: you've quit your job.
Your mother will be played by 老黄.
You're home! You've lost weight! Eat!

say.en: Tell her: you've quit your job.
say.tip: 辞职 cízhí = quit (a job). 把工作辞了 says the same, with the job up front.

ok.en: Then what will you eat? What will you drink?

answers: 妈，跟您说件事，我辞职了。
妈，有件事跟您说，我把工作辞了。
3.gloss: Mum, there's something I need to tell you. I've quit.
3.tip: 跟您说件事 = I need to tell you something: the warning before the news.

say.en: Reassure her: you have a plan.
say.gloss: Don't worry, I have a plan.
say.tip: 计划 jìhuà = a plan. 放心 = don't worry (put your heart down).

ok.en: So when are you getting married?

answers: 您别担心，我早就有计划了。
3.gloss: Don't you worry. I planned it all long ago.

say.en: Dodge it: we'll see when the time comes.
say.gloss: We'll see when the time comes.

not.note: Don't play dumb: put it off, 到时候再说吧.

say.tip: 到时候再说 = cross that bridge when we get there: the dodge for every family question.

answers: 妈，这事不急，到时候再说吧。
这个不急，到时候再说吧。
3.gloss: Mum, there's no rush. We'll see when the time comes.

steps.narr: 老黄 takes off the apron.

steps.zh: 我年轻的时候，也辞过职。跟你一样大。
steps.en: When I was young, I quit my job too. Your age.

steps.zh: 我儿子，到现在没跟我说过话。
steps.en: My son hasn't spoken to me since.

steps.zh: 林老师，能不能……也练练我的？
steps.en: 林老师, could we... rehearse mine too?

say.en: Rehearse his, or keep to yours.
say.tip: 帮您练 = help you rehearse: 帮 + you + the verb.

then.narr: 老黄 ties the apron back on.

answers: 我的不急，我们先帮您练吧。
我的不急，先帮您练您的。
3.gloss: Mine can wait. Let's do yours first.

answers: 您先别急，还是继续练我的吧。
alts.gloss: Hold on. Let's carry on with mine, after all.

steps.en: That night 林老师 starts building a new room: a small flat, with a door. 🚪

else.en: Sunday. You say it. Your mother only asks if you've eaten. 老黄 would be proud. 🍲
